events.title: British protectorate
hints: A queen asked for British protection in 1888, fearing French intervention.
A British Resident was appointed in 1891.
A neighbouring dominion took over in 1901.
events.summary: Fearing French designs, the chiefs of Rarotonga asked for British protection in 1888, and a British Resident was installed in 1891. The islands were annexed to New Zealand in 1901.

events.title: New Zealand rule
hints: The group was annexed to a dominion in 1901.
Land was subject to restrictions on sale and a Resident Commissioner governed.
Self-government in free association came in August 1965.
events.summary: New Zealand annexed the group in 1901 and governed it through a Resident Commissioner until the islands became self-governing in free association in 1965. Development lagged, and many islanders moved to New Zealand for work.
